setup.zh: 豫鼎从洛水里升起来。鼎身上铸着伊、洛、瀍、涧——豫州的一切，天下的中间。第九道雷落下来，不落在你身上，落在九口鼎的中间。
setup.en: The Cauldron of Yu rises from the Luo, cast with the Yi, the Luo, the Chan and the Jian — everything of Yu, the centre of the world. The ninth thunder falls — not on you, but into the midst of the nine.

recap.zh: 豫鼎升起，第九道雷落在九鼎中间。九鼎聚齐了。
recap.en: The Cauldron of Yu rose, and the ninth thunder fell into the midst of the nine. The nine were gathered.

text.zh: 九鼎聚齐了。……九个影子都回来了。我以为会再没有地方落——原来只有一轮。
text.en: The nine are gathered. …All nine reflections have come back. I thought there would be nowhere left to fall — and there was only ever one.

alone.zh: 洛水上的月影晃了晃，又合成一个，比哪一夜都圆。
alone.en: The moon on the Luo wavers, then closes into one, rounder than on any night before.

exits.means: carries the nine cauldrons to Luoyi and sets them on their footings, gives the breath back to the nine provinces

text.zh: 你把九口鼎捧到洛邑，一口一口放回石座上——冀、兖、青、徐、扬、荆、梁、雍，最后是豫。鼎一落座，灵脉就从石座底下往外流，往北，往东，往南，往西，流回九州的每一条水里。各州留下的，是鼎的气，不是鼎的铜。
text.en: You carry the nine to Luoyi and set them on their footings one by one — Ji, Yan, Qing, Xu, Yang, Jing, Liang, Yong, and last of all Yu. As each settles, the spirit veins flow out from under its footing — north, east, south, west — back into every river of the nine provinces. What each province keeps is the cauldron's breath, not its bronze.

text.zh: 定鼎于郏鄏。……一、二、三……九。数齐了。
text.en: The cauldrons are set at Jiaru. …One, two, three… nine. All counted.

alone.zh: 九口鼎都落了座。风里像有人在数数，从一数到九。
alone.en: All nine are seated. On the wind someone seems to be counting, from one to nine.

exits.means: hesitates, asks what will happen, wants to prepare first

text.zh: 两千年了，它们等得起这一晚。
text.en: Two thousand years — they can wait one more night.

alone.zh: 两千年了，九鼎等得起这一晚。
alone.en: Two thousand years: the nine can wait one more night.
